scope.request: Bounded read-only source transport and frozen input audit for original CG1AT BTC185 R4/R5/R6. Parent last reported R6 running at 421 seconds with stderr 0; that historical status was not rechecked and runtime status/results remain parent-owned.
done: read source/config/manifests and public sanitized book payloads
hash NPZ bytes without loading NPZ arrays
verify R6 META/fixture/book-tape joins and source-level execution contract
not_done: no database writes or frozen stage edits
no receipts, result outputs, winner/settlement fields, or PnL inspected

decision_source_parent.interpretation: 77 source files match the declared original CG1AT parent; only patches.py and worker.py differ. worker.py is orchestration/transport. SOURCE_PARENT.only_adapted_module names patches.py; worker.py is a separate orchestration replacement, not an alpha source change.

runtime_hashes.interpretation: 42 stage files already match final pins; two staged raw inputs match R2 smoke before hashes and the recorded after hashes match final pins. This supports the intended final 44 runtime hashes after the installer; this audit did not execute it.

R4_R5_transport.R4: Fixture conversion_info passes through without META conversion fields, while frozen plan needs meta.lastReceivedMs at EOF. Parent reported a terminal R4 KeyError after all frames; not independently inspected or rerun.
R4_R5_transport.R5_R6: Transport asserts fixture firstReceivedMs equals META conversion firstReceivedMs then overlays exact META conversion; merged mapping equals META for all 185 and fixture has no extra keys.
R4_R5_transport.expiry: Replay computes window_end_ms for frame context but processes every update without breaking at expiry, then advances to META lastReceivedMs.

R6_plan_reuse.prepare_resume: Static source requires reused raw result COMPLETE, active_matches_opportunity false and all other safety_gate values excluding pass/active key true before computing file hash proof.

exit_gate_contract.frozen_runner: Seven boolean predicates plus pass (8 total entries); pass=all(entries); raises SystemExit(2) unless status COMPLETE and pass true. Overlay rethrows nonzero SystemExit and single_path does not swallow it, so rc0 implies COMPLETE and all emitted predicate gates true under pinned source.
exit_gate_contract.R6_rc2_legacy_acceptance: R6 worker permits raw COMPLETE/rc2 only with active_matches_opportunity exactly false, all other gate entries except pass and active key truthy, no execution_clock capture_error/invalid and frames==source_updates==producer_calls. active_opportunity instrumentation substitutes passive_only_has_no_active with active_matches_opportunity; coordination expands its count for coordination submissions. The frozen source emits exactly eight safety_gate entries including pass. Worker does not separately assert an exact gate key set, though this pinned source chain defines the emitted set. Raw false and rc2 are retained; all_old_gates_passed is written false.
exit_gate_contract.result_interpretation: Not inspected; parent owns exact per-path gates/accounting.
